Triage: first-touch graded — promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, `bug`. (Triage seat, session `session_0185aJyu6TRnHbcVgSfGPSho`.)

Rationale: user-visible contradiction on a compliance-shaped surface (failure banner + measured "0 events" + the positive claim "No save, publish, rollback… recorded" rendered simultaneously), and the fix is minimal with in-file precedent — #5110's arm shape, which History/Related/Diagnostics on the same page already hold; this panel is the measured odd one out. Scope for dispatch: make the failure its own arm so the count and empty state are reachable only from a completed read — nothing else.

Claim: PM loop round 2 — **folded into the in-flight #5170 as one family dispatch**
Session: `session_01RV6yuVCxymHYE16PL9vQkE`
Branch: `claude/issue-5170-picker-load-failure-states` (shared with #5170 — no separate branch)
Worktree: `objectui-issue-5170`
Domain: `repo:objectui` (execution seat)
File surface: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AuditPanel.tsx` + tests, added to #5170's existing surface (`ResourceEditPage.tsx`).
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` — same dev, same run, no second container.
Clause-②: no — an internal admin surface gains a state; nothing published moves.
Serial constraints cleared: same file family, same sub-directory, same dev. Folding **removes** a serial constraint rather than adding one — these two cards would otherwise have had to run one after the other, since two devs editing sibling files in `views/metadata-admin/**` is exactly the collision the app-shell exemption tells us to serialise.

## Why this is one job and not two

Both cards came out of **the same sweep** ordered on #5110, and they are the same defect in the same class: a **failed** load rendered as a **measured** result.

- **#5170** (`ResourceEditPage.tsx`) — three option-picker loaders `catch` into an empty list, with no error state and no log.
- **#5169** (this card, `AuditPanel.tsx`) — the `catch` sets an error **and** zeroes `events`, so the rose failure banner, a header count of `0 events`, and "No audit events yet — no save, publish, rollback, delete or reset attempts have been recorded for this item" all render **at once**, contradicting each other.

The fix is **one shape** for both, and it is already landed in this same directory by #5110: a discriminated union (`idle | loading | loaded | error`) so a fault cannot be spelled as a measurement. Splitting them across two devs would mean two people independently re-deriving the same union, with a real chance of two slightly different spellings landing in one directory — which is the drift this repo keeps filing cards about.

## The one place the two genuinely differ — do not flatten it

They need **opposite** treatments of the empty-state copy, and getting this backwards would be a regression:

- **#5170's pickers have no empty-state copy at all.** What is missing there is a state that does not exist. Purely additive — ⛔ do not invent an "empty" sentence.
- **#5169's panel already has empty-state copy, and that copy is a positive claim about the record** — "no save, publish, rollback, delete or reset attempts have been recorded for this item". That sentence is **correct** on a completed read and **a lie** on a failed one. Keep it; make it reachable only from `loaded`.

An audit tab is read for compliance-shaped questions ("did anyone touch this?"), so the false `0` is the part that matters most in the whole family.

## Free control group, already measured

#5169's card did the sweep control for us: `HistoryPanel`, `RelatedPanel` and `DiagnosticsPage` on the same page **already hold the correct three-state shape** and are named in the card. So the target shape has three in-tree references plus #5110's landed diff. ⛔ There is no reason to invent anything here — and if your union disagrees with all four, that is a signal to re-read, not to proceed.

The PR closes both: `Fixes #5170` and `Fixes #5169`.
